articles.summary: IRVING, Texas, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — CMC (NYSE: CMC), today announced that it has been CertifiedTM as a Great Place to Work ® in the United States, Poland and China. Great Place To Work® is a global organization that evaluates workplace culture, employee experience and leadership behaviors through employee surveys – specifically, how consistently employees experience a high-trust workplace. According to the survey, 82% of CMC employees said the company is a Great Place To Work® compared to 57% of employees at a typical U.S.-based company. “CMC’s success is driven by our people, and this recognition is especially meaningful because it reflects their feedback,” said Peter Matt, President and Chief Executive Officer of CMC. “Our employees play an important role in creating the culture we have across CMC. This certification reflects our team’s commitment to one another, our customers and the work we do every day.” CMC employs more than 13,000 people worldwide. For more than 110 years, generations of employees have helped shape the company’s growth and success, and their dedication, experience and contributions continue to be an important part of CMC today. articles.summary: IRVING, Texas, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Today, October 13, 2026, the board of directors of CMC (NYSE: CMC) declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share of CMC common stock. CMC’s 248th consecutive quarterly dividend will be paid on November 11, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on October 28, 2026. About CMC CMC is a Fortune 500® company headquartered in Irving, Texas, and a leading provider of early-stage construction solutions that support the foundational phases of modern infrastructure and building projects. Founded in 1915, CMC has grown from a single-site recycling operation to one of the largest U.S. manufacturers of steel reinforcing bar (“rebar”), a leading producer of subgrade soil stabilization and foundation enhancement solutions and a major supplier of concrete pipe and precast products. Through an extensive manufacturing network primarily located in the United States and Central Europe, with strategic operations in the United Kingdom, Europe and Asia, CMC serves infrastructure, non-residential, residential, industrial and energy markets. While often unseen, CMC’s products are essential to highways, bridges, airports, commercial buildings and other critical structures that support everyday life.
